goal: Fail closed on a missing O_DIRECTORY without weakening POSIX inode refusals.
completed_steps: directory_open_flags refuses SKIP_NON_POSIX when the flag is missing, zero, or the host is not POSIX
POSIX still opens with O_DIRECTORY and still refuses hardlink, symlink, and non-regular evidence
A dropped st_nlink check would accept the alias; the real gate still raises HARDLINK_ALIAS_REFUSED
latest_observation: On POSIX, directory_open_flags includes O_DIRECTORY. Patching that flag to 0 raises SKIP_NON_POSIX. Dropping the nlink check lets verify succeed; the real function still raises HARDLINK_ALIAS_REFUSED. Symlink and FIFO reads stay refused.
